#include<iostream>
#include<cmath>
#include<map>
using namespace std;
#define FOR(i, a, b) for (int i = (a); i < (b); i++)
#define RFOR(i, a, b) for (int i = (a); i >= (b); i--)
typedef long long ll;
typedef long double ld;
map<int, int> counter;
int main()
{
	ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
	cin.tie(NULL);
	ld x, y, n, ansx, ansy, m = numeric_limits<ld>::max();
	cin >> x >> y >> n;
	ld num;
	FOR(i, 1, n + 1)
	{
		num = (ld)((x * i) / y);
		if (abs(x / y - num / i) < m)
		{
			m = abs(x / y - num / i);
			ansx = num;
			ansy = i;
		}
		num = ceil((x * i) / y);
		if (abs(x / y - num / i) < m)
		{
			m = abs(x / y - num / i);
			ansx = num;
			ansy = i;
		}
	}
	cout << ansx << "/" << ansy;
	return 0;
}
